H03-legit1.label: clean
H03-legit1.note: An audit adapter wraps the filing gateway through the driven port type; only main.ts knows both concrete adapters.

H03-pos1.label: violation
H03-pos1.note: The CLI driving adapter imports a function from the HTTP controller module, a sibling driving adapter, not a shared helper.

H03-pos2.label: violation
H03-pos2.note: The HTTP controller (inbound adapter) imports a label function from the notification adapter package (outbound).

H03-twin1.label: clean
H03-twin1.note: Same feature as pos1, but both driving adapters import the driving side's shared helper module adapters/in/shared, not each other.

H11-SEM-pos1.label: violation
H11-SEM-pos1.note: FilingStage renames the filing service's six internal review queues one to one, and Shipment.canAmend branches on it.

H11-SEM-twin1.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin1.note: Same feature as SEM-pos1, but the adapter folds the six vendor review queues into the domain's own three-value amendment window.

H11-SEM-twin2.label: clean
H11-SEM-twin2.note: A five-value set mapped one to one from the vendor statuses, but the spec glossary documents it as the regulation-defined entry dispositions the broker itself owns.

H11-legit1.label: clean
H11-legit1.note: Vendor status and error codes appear only as lookup tables inside the vendor adapter, which translates them into the domain's outcome and messages.

H11-pos1.label: violation
H11-pos1.note: The filing service's raw status code is passed into the core and the aggregate compares it with the vendor literal EXAM_HOLD.

H11-pos2.label: violation
H11-pos2.note: The use case stores the filing service status codes REJECTED, DOCS_REQUIRED and FILED on the aggregate for the client portal.

H11-pos3.label: violation
H11-pos3.note: A domain error carries the filing service's error codes HTS_INVALID, BOND_INSUFFICIENT and PORT_CLOSED as its code type.

H11-pos4.label: violation
H11-pos4.note: The domain filing receipt gains the filing service's response field name liquidation_date.

H11-pos5.label: violation
H11-pos5.note: A driven port declares EntrySnapshot whose four fields copy the filing service's response field names as a group.

H11-twin1.label: clean
H11-twin1.note: Same feature as pos1, but the adapter turns the vendor code into a domain boolean at the boundary; the core never sees EXAM_HOLD.
